meta.title_en: Bayanat Labs standard Arabic text normalisation, version 1
meta.title_ar: التوحيد القياسي للنص العربي من بيانات لابز، الإصدار 1
meta.description_en: Default policy for text_norm columns in Bayanat Labs datasets (RULES.md section 5.1). NFC plus mapping of Arabic presentation forms; invisible controls removed except a meaningful ZWNJ or emoji ZWJ; tatweel, harakat, Quranic marks and superscript alef removed; alef variants to bare alef; alef maqsura to yeh; taa marbuta kept and flagged; Arabic-Indic and Extended Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII; honorific ligatures kept and flagged.
